ruleDefinitions.name: Use of Legacy Authentication Protocols
ruleDefinitions.description: Alert on when legacy authentication has been used on an account Note: Unmapped fields: ActivityDetails, ClientApp, Username

sequences.query: (ActivityDetails = "Sign\-ins" AND (ClientApp = "Other\ client" OR ClientApp = "IMAP" OR ClientApp = "POP3" OR ClientApp = "MAPI" OR ClientApp = "SMTP" OR ClientApp = "Exchange\ ActiveSync" OR ClientApp = "Exchange\ Web\ Services") AND Username = "UPN")
